notes.title: Version 2.0 - Japanese and Chinese language options, new features
notes.content:
Version 2.0 is a significant update, introducing new features, the original Japanese script, and new translations in Simplified and Traditional Chinese.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/f0cbbdff6f0db94ebeec0e23e5983402d0af1b26.png[/img]

When you start this new version for the first time, you will be asked to select a language. This will affect all in-game text, including menus. It can be changed at any time from the System menu, the fourth option on the title screen and the last option on the left side of the in-game text box.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/8ed004ce882be155d917afb9a961ccc0933da623.png[/img]

Several features first introduced in [i]A Kiss For The Petals - The New Generation![/i] have been added to this version:
[list]
[*]The ability to adjust the opacity of the text box freely.
[*]The option to render text with a shadow or outline, which can be changed independently of the text box opacity setting.
[*]An option to pause the text when a full-screen CG is shown. By default, it will pause until the user clicks.
[/list]
These options are available in the second page of the System menu.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10023194/7126d6af3892c9b66cd3eb1cc7c2f4f07dcd3179.png[/img]

Version 2.0 is built in Ren'Py 6.99.12.4, which features optimizations with the Steam overlay.

notes.title: A Kiss For The Petals - Remembering How We Met updated to version 1.1
notes.content:
This version has two major changes:

- Ren'Py has been updated to version 6.99.7. This version corrects a reported issue with replays from the Memories menu. If a replay ends with the Skip switch enabled, the Skip state was preserved, which affected the CG viewer and other menu elements. Ren'Py 6.99.7 terminates skipping when a replay ends.

- Achievement data is synchronized on program start. Any achievements earned in the MangaGamer.com version are unlocked on the Steam version during the opening logos when run from the same computer.
